name: Akash Madhwal
profileSummary: Akash Madhwal is an Indian cricketer who has played for Uttarakhand and Mumbai Indians as a bowler. He is well known for his trajectory and ability to get the ball to skid and rip through from a quick-arm action. He is known for his connection with Indian wicket-keeper batsman Rishabh Pant as his close neighbour as both live in the same area in Uttarakhand.
